name: Align
description: A widget that aligns its child within itself and optionally sizes itself based on the child's size.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: Defines how the child is aligned within the parent.
properties.possible_values: Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.topCenter, Alignment.topRight, Alignment.centerLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.centerRight, Alignment.bottomLeft, Alignment.bottomCenter, Alignment.bottomRight, Alignment(x, y)

properties.name: widthFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the width of the Align widget to be this factor times the child's width.

properties.name: heightFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the height of the Align widget to be this factor times the child's height.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to be aligned.
